prompt:
Task: Estimate the hourly average net electrical power output of a combined-cycle power plant at full load.
Target: net_electrical_power
Target unit: MW
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing or an invalid measurement replaced with missing.
Field definitions and context: AT: ambient temperature in degrees Celsius; V: exhaust vacuum in cm Hg; AP: ambient pressure in millibar; RH: relative humidity in percent. Inputs are contemporaneous operating measurements.
Input JSON: {"AT":14.96,"V":41.76,"AP":1024.07,"RH":73.17}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
